title: Thrive Capital led VCs into pro sports ownership; Collaborative Fund just upped that play | TechCrunch
summary: To recap, Joshua Kushner’s Thrive launched a new vehicle, Thrive Eternal, explicitly built to hold “iconic franchises and cultural institutions” for decades, funded by many of the same investors already in Thrive’s venture and growth funds.
